thread:
anna: FYI opened PR #4872 — adds SDK snippet for private deployment + KMS example. Marked as sensitive because it references a customer config. Need legal + security ok before merge. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4872
marcus: re: code sample looks good to me for API usage. ran it locally quick. :thumbsup:
lee: tagging security — I need to review the KMS example to ensure no accidental secrets or network patterns that leak metadata. Can you highlight the parts that reference customer config? :lock:
anna: the only sensitive line is the config example under "onprem-example" that uses `customer_domain: example-corp`. I can redact to `customer_domain: <REDACTED>` if legal wants that.
sanjay: legal here — thanks for the ping. We need two things: (1) remove any real customer identifiers and (2) add a short legal blurb about sharing sample configs that are not production-ready. I'll paste a suggested paragraph in a sec.
tessa: I can update the SDK snippet simultaneously — there was an outdated param name `kms_key` -> `encryption_key_id`. Will push a small commit to the PR once legal confirms redaction text.
docs-bot: Preview published: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/4872 (Netlify). HTML diff: 3 changed files. CI: docs-build ✅, lint ✅, spellcheck ⚠️ (one warning).
lee: thanks @anna. If you redact the domain and remove any example access tokens we're fine. Also prefer a comment instead of inline example secrets, e.g.:
```
# DO NOT USE REAL TOKENS
encryption_key_id: "projects/PROJECT/locations/global/keyRings/EXAMPLE/cryptoKeys/REDACTED"
```
anna: doing that now. also adding a short section: "How to replace placeholders with your own managed keys" to avoid implying prod defaults.
marcus: quick note on merge timing — we have a release window tomorrow 10:00 PST. If we get approvals by EOD today we can include it; otherwise hold to next window.
sanjay: drafting legal blurb: "Note: configuration examples are for illustration only. Do not paste production secrets into documentation. Follow your corporate security policy when reusing snippets." ok?
lee: LGTM. also request: add a security contact line: `If you discover sensitive data, contact security@redwood.com`
tessa: pushed a commit for the `encryption_key_id` rename and placeholder comments. PR shows 2 new commits.
docs-bot: CI update: docs-build ✅, lint ✅, spellcheck ✅, preview updated: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.com/4872/
anna: added legal blurb + redacted example and security contact. removed `example-corp` domain.
marcus: I reviewed the latest commit — examples still compile with the new param name. :white_check_mark:
sanjay: Legal sign-off: approved with redactions and the blurb included. Please retain audit trail of the change in the PR description.
lee: Security sign-off: approved after redactions. no further edits from security.
anna: great — I'll wait 30 min for any last comments, then merge and schedule a docs minor deploy outside the main release window to reduce risk.
marcus: Ack. Thanks everyone.
docs-bot: Merge check: all required approvals present (legal, security, docs). Auto-merge scheduled in 30m.
anna: merged and cherry-picked the minor fix into main. Deploy in progress.
docs-bot: Deploy complete: https://docs.redwood-inference.com/?updated=4872 — live. Thanks team.
marcus: nice! saved us from an accidental leak. :relieved:
